title: The web’s newest weapon against AI scrapers is a font
summary: On average, ShieldFont ends up replacing 24.5 percent of all words on a page, including 45.8 percent of all “content words,” marring the meaning of anywhere from 31 to 56 percent of individual passages (depending on the corpus studied).
